parameters.jsCode: const x=$json.body||$json,target=10,orders=+x.orders||0,sessions=+x.sessions||0,gap=Math.max(0,target-orders),cvr=sessions?orders/sessions:0,seo=x.seoOpportunities||[],comp=x.competitors||[],a=[]; if(seo.length){const s=[...seo].sort((a,b)=>(b.opportunityScore||0)-(a.opportunityScore||0))[0];a.push({priority:1,channel:'SEO',action:s.action||'Optimize highest-scoring query/page',reason:(s.query||'Top query')+' | position '+(s.position??'n/a')});} if(gap)a.push({priority:2,channel:'Conversion',action:'Improve conversion on highest-traffic Queen Street landing/menu page',reason:'Order gap '+gap+'; CVR '+(cvr*100).toFixed(1)+'%'}); if(comp.length)a.push({priority:3,channel:'Local/Competitor',action:'Review strongest competitor offer/review theme and test a differentiated Queen Street offer',reason:comp[0].competitor||'Top competitor'}); while(a.length<3)a.push({priority:a.length+1,channel:'Retention',action:'Run an approved repeat-order/lunch offer',reason:'Use owned demand'}); return [{json:{date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),location:'Queen Street',target,orders,orderGap:gap,sessions,conversionRate:cvr,topActions:a.slice(0,3)}}];
